title: Judge declines to sign order sealing Josh Jacobs video, on procedural grounds

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Judge declines to sign order sealing Josh Jacobs video, on procedural grounds
sources.description: A week after the judge presiding over the criminal case involving Packers running back Josh Jacobs signed an order temporarily sealing the evidence (including a video of the altercation that prompted a misdemeanor battery charge), the judge declined to sign an order that would have sealed the evidence permanently.
